name: Tap2PC
description: Tap2PC is a lightweight, local-first remote control and file sharing system that lets you manage your PC from a mobile device via a web browser. Running entirely on LAN with no cloud, login, or external dependencies, it provides fast and secure control for actions like shutdown, restart, sleep, lock, and data sharing — similar to TeamViewer but simpler and browser-based.
author: Tanjimul Islam Sabbir
